title: Errors
subtitle: Errors your app reports through any Sentry SDK, grouped into issues and tied to the deploy that produced them.

setup.title: Send errors from this app
setup.off: Error tracking is off. Turn it on to get a DSN for your Sentry SDK.
setup.on: Error tracking is on. Set SENTRY_DSN to the DSN you were given, or rotate it for a new one.
setup.dsnOnce: This DSN is shown once. Set it on the app and redeploy. Rotating makes the old DSN stop working.
setup.disabledToast: Error tracking is off. The app's SDK will get 401 responses.

list.empty: No errors in this window. Once your SDK reports one it shows up here.

detail.noStack: This event carried no stack trace.
